claims.statement: In Christian mythology, Lucifer is associated with the Devil and a fallen angel.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Kristen, nama Lucifer dikaitkan dengan Iblis dan malaikat jatuh.
claims.quote: In Christian mythology, the name Lucifer has been associated with the Devil and the fallen angel

claims.statement: Lucifer is a name for the morning star, Venus before sunrise.
claims.statement_id: Lucifer adalah nama Latin bagi bintang fajar, yakni Venus saat tampak sebelum matahari terbit.
claims.quote: the name given to the “morning star,” i.e. the planet Venus when it appears above the E. horizon before sunrise

claims.statement: Isaiah used the day-star expression poetically for the king of Babylon.
claims.statement_id: Yesaya memakai ungkapan bintang siang secara puitis bagi raja Babilonia.
claims.quote: The term “day star” (so rendered in the Revised Version) was used poetically by Isaiah for the king of Babylon

claims.statement: In Christian theology, Lucifer became a name for Satan before his fall.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teologi Kristen, Lucifer kemudian dipandang sebagai nama Setan sebelum kejatuhannya.
claims.quote: in Christian theology, Lucifer came to be regarded as the name of Satan before his fall

claims.statement: In classical Rome, Lucifer was not typically considered a deity and had few myths.
claims.statement_id: Dalam masa Romawi klasik, Lucifer biasanya tidak dianggap dewa dan nyaris tidak memiliki mitos sendiri.
claims.quote: In the classical Roman period, Lucifer was not typically regarded as a deity and had few, if any, myths

claims.statement: The Latin name Lucifer means light-bringer and named Venus.
claims.statement_id: Kata Latin Lucifer berarti pembawa cahaya dan menjadi nama Venus.
claims.quote: Lucifer ("light-bringer" in Latin) was the name of the planet Venus

claims.statement: In Roman representations the star was often personified as a torch-bearing male.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penggambaran Romawi, bintang itu kerap dipersonifikasikan sebagai laki-laki pembawa obor.
claims.quote: though it was often personified as a male figure bearing a torch

claims.statement: Greek names for Venus included Phosphoros and Eosphoros.
claims.statement_id: Nama Yunani bagi Venus antara lain Phosphoros dan Eosphoros.
claims.quote: The Greek name for this planet was variously Phosphoros Φωσφόρος (also meaning "light-bringer") or Heosphoros /Eosphoros

claims.statement: The prophetic passage condemns the king of Babylon.
claims.statement_id: Pasal tersebut ditujukan kepada raja Babilonia dalam nubuat.
claims.quote: the king of Babylon is condemned in a prophetic vision

claims.statement: Later Christian interpretation used the name for the devil before his fall.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tafsir Kristen berikutnya, nama itu dipakai bagi iblis sebelum jatuh.
claims.quote: the original name of the devil before his fall from grace

claims.statement: In the Middle Ages Lucifer became the most popular name.
claims.statement_id: Pada Abad Pertengahan, Lucifer menjadi nama yang paling populer bagi sosok tersebut.
claims.quote: Lucifer became the most popular name in the Middle Ages.

claims.statement: The interpretation received literary expression in Milton's Paradise Lost.
claims.statement_id: Penafsiran itu mendapat penggambaran sastra dalam Paradise Lost karya Milton.
claims.quote: This idea finds its most magnificent literary expression in Milton’s Paradise Lost

claims.statement: Lucifer is the Latin equivalent of Greek Phosphoros.
claims.statement_id: Lucifer adalah padanan Latin nama Yunani Phosphoros.
claims.quote: The Latin word corresponding to Greek Phosphoros is Lucifer.

claims.statement: Roman poetry often portrays Lucifer as heralding dawn.
claims.statement_id: Puisi Romawi kerap menampilkan Lucifer sebagai pertanda fajar.
claims.quote: He was often presented in poetry as heralding the dawn.

claims.statement: The name was sometimes also used for Venus as an evening star.
claims.statement_id: Nama tersebut kadang digunakan juga bagi Venus ketika tampak sebagai bintang senja.
claims.quote: sometimes also to the “evening star,” i.e. the same planet in the W. sky after sundown

claims.statement: According to the Church teaching cited in the Catholic Encyclopedia, the Devil and the other demons were created by God good in their nature but made themselves evil.
claims.statement_id: Menurut ajaran Gereja yang dikutip Catholic Encyclopedia, Iblis dan para setan lain diciptakan Allah baik menurut kodratnya, tetapi mereka sendiri menjadikan diri jahat.
claims.quote: the Devil and the other demons were created by God good in their nature but they by themselves have made themselves evil

claims.statement: The Catholic Encyclopedia states that, with the article, "the Devil" denotes Lucifer, the chief of the fallen angels.
claims.statement_id: Catholic Encyclopedia menyebut bahwa dengan kata sandang, "Iblis" menunjuk Lucifer, pemimpin para malaikat jatuh.
claims.quote: it denotes Lucifer, their chief, as in Matthew 25:41

claims.statement: Apocalypse 12, cited by the Catholic Encyclopedia as the picture of the fall of the angels: a great battle in heaven in which Michael and his angels fought the dragon, who did not prevail and found no more place in heaven.
claims.statement_id: Wahyu 12 (dikutip Catholic Encyclopedia sebagai gambaran kejatuhan malaikat): terjadi pertempuran besar di surga; Mikhael dan malaikatnya melawan naga, yang tidak menang dan tidak lagi mendapat tempat di surga.
claims.quote: And there was a great battle in heaven, Michael and his angels fought with the dragon, and the dragon fought and his angels: and they prevailed not, neither was their place found any more in heaven.

claims.statement: The great dragon, the old serpent called the devil and Satan, who seduces the whole world, was cast to the earth and his angels were thrown down with him.
claims.statement_id: Naga besar itu, ular tua yang disebut Iblis dan Satan yang menyesatkan seluruh dunia, dicampakkan ke bumi bersama malaikat-malaikatnya.
claims.quote: And that great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, who seduceth the whole world; and he was cast unto the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

claims.statement: In Isaiah 14 as cited by the Catholic Encyclopedia, the fallen figure says he will ascend into heaven and exalt his throne above the stars of God, but is told he will be brought down to hell.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Yesaya 14 yang dikutip Catholic Encyclopedia, tokoh yang jatuh itu berkata akan naik ke langit dan meninggikan takhtanya di atas bintang-bintang Allah, tetapi akan diturunkan ke neraka.
claims.quote: I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God ... I will be like the most High. But yet thou shalt be brought down to hell

claims.statement: The prophet's parable is expressly directed against the King of Babylon, but both the early Fathers and later Catholic commentators understand it as applying with deeper significance to the fall of the rebel angel.
claims.statement_id: Perumpamaan Yesaya itu secara tegas ditujukan kepada raja Babel, tetapi para Bapa Gereja awal dan penafsir Katolik kemudian menerapkannya dengan makna lebih dalam pada kejatuhan malaikat pemberontak.
claims.quote: This parable of the prophet is expressly directed against the King of Babylon, but both the early Fathers and later Catholic commentators agree in understanding it as applying with deeper significance to the fall of the rebel angel.

claims.statement: Many authorities regard the great offense of Lucifer as the desire for independence of God and equality with God.
claims.statement_id: Banyak otoritas menganggap dosa besar Lucifer adalah keinginan untuk bebas dari Allah dan setara dengan Allah.
claims.quote: by many of the best authorities is regarded as being actually the great offense of Lucifer, to wit, the desire of independence of God and equality with God.

claims.statement: Lucifer is seen as holding a certain sovereignty over those who followed him in his rebellion.
claims.statement_id: Lucifer dipandang memegang kedaulatan tertentu atas mereka yang mengikutinya dalam pemberontakan.
claims.quote: it appears that he holds a certain sovereignty over those who followed him in his rebellion.

claims.statement: The fall of the angels did not impair their natural powers, and Lucifer retained the gifts that enabled him to influence his fellow angels.
claims.statement_id: Kejatuhan para malaikat tidak merusak kuasa kodrati mereka, dan Lucifer tetap memegang karunia yang memungkinkannya memengaruhi saudara-saudaranya.
claims.quote: the fall of the angels did not impair their natural powers, that Lucifer still retained the gifts that enabled him to influence his brethren before their fall

claims.statement: Besides his authority over "his angels", Satan has extended his empire over the minds of evil men.
claims.statement_id: Selain menguasai "malaikat-malaikatnya", Satan memperluas kerajaannya atas pikiran orang-orang jahat.
claims.quote: Satan has extended his empire over the minds of evil men.

claims.statement: Quoting St. Gregory, the Catholic Encyclopedia calls the Devil the head of all the wicked, of which head all the wicked are members.
claims.statement_id: Mengutip Santo Gregorius, Catholic Encyclopedia menyebut Iblis sebagai kepala semua orang jahat, dan semua orang jahat adalah anggota kepala itu.
claims.quote: Surely the Devil is the head of all the wicked; and of this head all the wicked are members

claims.statement: The Catholic Encyclopedia states that his course after the fall has shown him the relentless enemy of mankind.
claims.statement_id: Catholic Encyclopedia menyatakan bahwa jalan hidupnya sesudah jatuh menunjukkan Iblis sebagai musuh manusia yang tak kenal henti.
claims.quote: his subsequent course has certainly shown him the relentless enemy of mankind

claims.statement: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, the activity of Satan does much more than add temptation: it means a combination and an intelligent direction of all the elements of evil.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia, kegiatan Satan bukan sekadar menambah godaan, tetapi berarti gabungan dan pengarahan cerdas atas segala unsur kejahatan.
claims.quote: the activity of Satan does much more than merely add a further source of temptation to the weakness of the world and the flesh; it means a combination and an intelligent direction of all the elements of evil.

claims.statement: The teaching cited in the Catholic Encyclopedia states that in the next world the wicked shall suffer perpetual punishment with the Devil.
claims.statement_id: Ajaran yang dikutip Catholic Encyclopedia menyatakan bahwa di dunia berikutnya orang-orang jahat akan menderita hukuman abadi bersama Iblis.
claims.quote: in the next world the wicked shall suffer perpetual punishment with the Devil

claims.statement: Isaiah 14:16-17 (KJV) asks of the fallen one: is this the man that made the earth tremble and shook kingdoms, that made the world a wilderness and destroyed its cities?
claims.statement_id: Yesaya 14:16-17 (KJV) bertanya tentang yang jatuh itu: inikah orang yang membuat bumi gemetar, menggoncang kerajaan-kerajaan, menjadikan dunia padang belantara, dan menghancurkan kota-kotanya?
claims.quote: Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms; 17 That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof

claims.statement: Revelation 12:9 (KJV): the great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, which deceives the whole world, was cast out into the earth and his angels were cast out with him.
claims.statement_id: Wahyu 12:9 (KJV): naga besar itu, ular tua yang disebut Iblis dan Satan, yang menyesatkan seluruh dunia, dicampakkan ke bumi dan malaikat-malaikatnya dicampakkan bersamanya.
claims.quote: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

claims.statement: The older commentators generally consider the Lord's words "I saw Satan like lightning falling from heaven" (Luke 10:18) to confirm the interpretation of the fall of Lucifer.
claims.statement_id: Para penafsir lama umumnya menganggap kata-kata Tuhan, "Aku melihat Satan jatuh seperti kilat dari langit" (Lukas 10:18), meneguhkan tafsir kejatuhan Lucifer.
claims.quote: And the older commentators generally consider that this interpretation is confirmed by the words of Our Lord to his disciples: "I saw Satan like lightning falling from heaven

claims.statement: Modern commentators take the text differently: not the original fall of Satan but his overthrow by the faith of the disciples, who cast out devils in the name of their Master.
claims.statement_id: Penafsir modern memahami teks itu secara berbeda: bukan kejatuhan awal Satan, melainkan kekalahannya oleh iman para murid yang mengusir setan atas nama Guru mereka.
claims.quote: But modern commentators take this text in a different sense, and refer it not to the original fall of Satan, but his overthrow by the faith of the disciples, who cast out devils in the name of their Master.

claims.statement: Nyx was a primordial goddess of night in Greek mythology.
claims.statement_id: Nyx adalah dewi malam purba dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: NYX was the goddess of the night, one of the primordial gods (protogenoi) who emerged as the dawn of creation.

claims.statement: Nyx personifies night in Greek mythology.
claims.statement_id: Nyx adalah personifikasi malam dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: is the personification of the night in Greek mythology

claims.statement: Hesiod says Erebus and Night came from Chaos.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Erebus dan Malam berasal dari Chaos.
claims.quote: From Chaos came forth Erebus and black Night

claims.statement: Night and Erebus produced Aether and Day.
claims.statement_id: Nyx bersama Erebus melahirkan Aether dan Day.
claims.quote: and coupling with Erebos (Darkness) she produced Aither (Aether, Light) and Hemera (Day).

claims.statement: Nyx alone bore spirits including Sleep, Death, Strife and Pain.
claims.statement_id: Nyx juga melahirkan sendiri sejumlah roh, termasuk Tidur, Kematian, Perselisihan, dan Rasa Sakit.
claims.quote: Alone she spawned a brood of dark spirits including the three Fates, Sleep, Death, Strife and Pain.

claims.statement: Hemera embodies Day opposite Nyx at dawn.
claims.statement_id: Hemera melambangkan Siang yang menggantikan malam pada fajar.
claims.quote: Her opposite number was Hemera (Day) who scattered the mists of night at dawn.

claims.statement: Ancient art depicts Nyx as winged or driving a chariot.
claims.statement_id: Seni kuno menggambarkan Nyx sebagai dewi bersayap atau pengendara kereta.
claims.quote: In ancient art Nyx was depicted as a either a winged goddess or charioteer

claims.statement: In the Iliad, Hypnos says Nyx rescued him from Zeus.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Iliad, Hypnos mengaku diselamatkan Nyx dari murka Zeus.
claims.quote: had not Nyx (Night) who has power over gods and men rescued me

claims.statement: Nyx is depicted driving a chariot with a black or starry veil.
claims.statement_id: Nyx digambarkan mengendarai kereta dengan selubung hitam atau berbintang.
claims.quote: Nyx drives a chariot, all cloaked in black, with a starry or black veil and stars following in her wake.

claims.statement: Nyx and Hemera alternate their presence in Tartarus.
claims.statement_id: Nyx dan Hemera bergantian keluar dari kediaman mereka di Tartarus.
claims.quote: Although Nyx & Hemera both dwell in Tartarus, they are never home at the same time

claims.statement: There is very little evidence of temple worship of Nyx.
claims.statement_id: Bukti pemujaan Nyx di kuil sangat sedikit.
claims.quote: there is very little evidence of any worship taking place in temples

claims.statement: Pausanias mentions an Oracle of Night at Megara.
claims.statement_id: Pausanias menyebut orakel Malam di Megara.
claims.quote: mentions an Oracle of the Night in Megara

claims.statement: One Orphic genealogy gives Phanes as Nyx's parent.
claims.statement_id: Satu silsilah Orfik memberi Phanes sebagai orang tua Nyx.
claims.quote: [2.1] PHANES (Orphic Argonautica 12, Orphic Fragment 101)

claims.statement: Hesiodic genealogy gives Khaos as Nyx's parent.
claims.statement_id: Silsilah Hesiod memberi Khaos sebagai asal Nyx.
claims.quote: [1.1] KHAOS (Hesiod Theogony 123, Nonnus Dionysiaca 31.115)

claims.statement: Nyx is also known as Nox.
claims.statement_id: Nyx juga dikenal sebagai Nox.
claims.quote: Nyx (also known as Nox or the Night)

claims.statement: A classical dictionary entry reproduced on Theoi says Homer calls Nyx the subduer of gods and men and that Zeus himself stood in awe of her.
claims.statement_id: Entri kamus klasik yang dimuat Theoi menyebut bahwa Homer menjuluki Nyx penakluk dewa dan manusia, dan bahwa Zeus sendiri segan kepadanya.
claims.quote: NYX (Nux), Nox or Night personified. Homer (Il. xiv. 259, &c.) calls her the subduer of gods and men, and relates that Zeus himself stood in awe of her.

claims.statement: In Hesiod's Theogony, Night bears Doom, Fate, Death, Sleep and the tribe of Dreams, and, though she lay with none, Blame, Woe and the Hesperides.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony Hesiod, Night melahirkan Doom, Fate, Death, Sleep, dan suku Dreams; dan tanpa berbaring dengan siapa pun ia melahirkan Blame, Woe, dan para Hesperides.
claims.quote: And Night bare hateful Doom and black Fate and Death, and she bare Sleep and the tribe of Dreams. And again the goddess murky Night, though she lay with none, bare Blame and painful Woe, and the Hesperides who guard the rich, golden apples and the trees bearing fruit beyond glorious Ocean.

claims.statement: In Hesiod's Theogony, Aether and Day were born of Night, who conceived and bore them from union in love with Erebus.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony Hesiod, Aether dan Day lahir dari Night, yang mengandung dan melahirkan mereka dari persatuan cinta dengan Erebus.
claims.quote: but of Night were born Aether ... and Day, whom she conceived and bare from union in love with Erebus.

claims.statement: Hesiod describes the awful home of murky Night wrapped in dark clouds, where Night and Day draw near and greet one another at the great bronze threshold, and while one is about to enter the house the other comes out at the door.
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menggambarkan rumah Night yang mengerikan, terbungkus awan gelap; di ambang pintu perunggu yang besar, Night dan Day saling mendekat dan menyapa, dan ketika yang satu hendak masuk ke rumah, yang lain keluar lewat pintu.
claims.quote: There stands the awful home of murky Night wrapped in dark clouds. ... where Night and Day draw near and greet one another as they pass the great threshold of bronze: and while the one is about to go down into the house, the other comes out at the door.

claims.statement: Hesiod says the children of dark Night, Sleep and Death, awful gods, have their dwellings there.
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menyebut anak-anak Night yang gelap, Sleep dan Death, para dewa yang mengerikan, bertempat tinggal di sana.
claims.quote: And there the children of dark Night have their dwellings, Sleep and Death, awful gods.

claims.statement: In Aristophanes' Birds (as quoted on Theoi), black-winged Nyx lays a germless egg in the deeps of Erebos, and after long ages the graceful Eros springs from it.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Birds karya Aristophanes (kutipan di Theoi), Nyx bersayap hitam bertelur tanpa benih di kedalaman Erebos, dan setelah masa yang panjang dari telur itu lahir Eros yang anggun.
claims.quote: Firstly, black-winged Nyx (Night) laid a germless egg in the bosom of the infinite deeps of Erebos (Darkness), and from this, after the revolution of long ages, sprang the graceful Eros

claims.statement: In Aeschylus' Eumenides (as quoted on Theoi), the Erinyes call themselves the eternal children of Nyx and say they are called Arai (Curses) in their homes beneath the earth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Eumenides karya Aeschylus (kutipan di Theoi), para Erinyes menyebut diri mereka anak-anak abadi Nyx dan disebut Arai (Curses) di rumah mereka di bawah bumi.
claims.quote: We [the Erinyes] are the eternal children of Nyx (Night). We are called Arai (Arae, Curses) in our homes beneath the earth.

claims.statement: Pausanias writes that the inscriptions identify the figures as Thanatos (Death) and Hypnos (Sleep), with Nyx (Night) the nurse of both.
claims.statement_id: Pausanias menulis bahwa prasasti mengidentifikasi sosok-sosok itu sebagai Thanatos (Death) dan Hypnos (Sleep), dengan Nyx (Night) sebagai pengasuh keduanya.
claims.quote: The inscriptions declare, as one could infer without inscriptions, that the figures are Thanatos (Death) and Hypnos (Sleep), with Nyx (Night) the nurse of both.

claims.statement: Pausanias records that the people of Smyrna believe in two Nemeses instead of one and say Nyx was their mother.
claims.statement_id: Pausanias mencatat bahwa orang Smyrna percaya pada dua Nemesis, bukan satu, dan mengatakan Nyx adalah ibu mereka.
claims.quote: They [the people of Smyrna] believe in two Nemeses instead of one; they say Nyx was their mother.

claims.statement: In an Orphic fragment (as quoted on Theoi), Phanes places his distinguished sceptre, the rulership of the universe, in the hands of the goddess Nyx so that she holds royalty.
claims.statement_id: Dalam fragmen Orfik (kutipan di Theoi), Phanes menaruh tongkat kerajaannya yang mulia, yakni kekuasaan atas alam semesta, di tangan dewi Nyx agar ia memegang kerajaan.
claims.quote: [Phanes] placed his distinguished sceptre [the rulership of the universe] in the hands of goddess Nyx (Night), that she hold royalty

claims.statement: In one Orphic creation story, Phanes gives birth to Nyx, and Phanes and Nyx then conceive Uranus (Heaven).
claims.statement_id: Dalam salah satu kisah penciptaan Orfik, Phanes melahirkan Nyx, lalu Phanes dan Nyx bersama-sama memperanakkan Uranus (Heaven).
claims.quote: Phanes gives birth to Nyx, and Phanes and Nyx then go on to conceive Uranus (Heaven).

claims.statement: Black animals, especially black cocks, which announced the coming of morning, were said to be sacrificed to her.
claims.statement_id: Hewan-hewan hitam, terutama ayam jantan hitam yang mengumumkan datangnya pagi, dikatakan dikurbankan kepadanya.
claims.quote: However, black animals were said to be sacrificed to her, especially black cocks, as they announced the coming of morning, even in the presence of Night.

claims.statement: Some scholars believe Nyx could have been a supreme deity in early Orphic belief.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian sarjana percaya Nyx mungkin pernah menjadi dewa tertinggi dalam kepercayaan Orfik awal.
claims.quote: Some scholars believe that Nyx could have been a supreme deity in early Orphic belief.

claims.statement: In other sources, Nyx is described as a floating figure in a long black robe who carries her sons Thanatos (Death) and Hypnos (Sleep) in her arms.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sumber lain, Nyx digambarkan sebagai sosok melayang berjubah hitam panjang yang menggendong putra-putranya, Thanatos (Death) dan Hypnos (Sleep).
claims.quote: In other sources, she is described as a floating figure clad in a long black robe who carries her sons Thanatos (Death) and Hypnos (Sleep) in her arms.

claims.statement: In Samuel Butler's translation of the Iliad on Perseus, Hypnos says that Night, who cows both men and gods, protected him; he fled to her and Zeus left off looking for him, not daring to do anything to displease Night.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan Iliad karya Samuel Butler di Perseus, Hypnos mengatakan bahwa Night, yang menakutkan manusia dan dewa, melindunginya; ia lari kepadanya dan Zeus berhenti mencarinya karena tidak berani berbuat apa pun yang menyinggung Night.
claims.quote: had not Night who cows both men and gods protected me. I fled to her and Zeus left off looking for me in spite of his being so angry, for he did not dare do anything to displease Night.

claims.statement: Theoi lists the Roman name of Nyx as Nox and the translation of the name as Night (nyx, nyktos).
claims.statement_id: Theoi mencantumkan nama Romawi Nyx sebagai Nox dan terjemahan namanya sebagai Night (nyx, nyktos).
claims.quote: Transliteration Nyx Roman Name Nox Translation Night (nyx, nyktos)

claims.statement: Thoth is an Egyptian god of writing, magic, wisdom and the moon.
claims.statement_id: Thoth ialah dewa Mesir yang terkait dengan tulisan, sihir, kebijaksanaan, dan bulan.
claims.quote: Thoth is the Egyptian god of writing, magic, wisdom, and the moon.

claims.statement: Thoth is a Greek name for the Egyptian deity.
claims.statement_id: Thoth adalah bentuk nama Yunani untuk dewa Mesir tersebut.
claims.quote: THOTH, the Greek name of the Egyptian god of letters, invention and wisdom

claims.statement: His Egyptian name Djehuty means He Who is Like the Ibis.
claims.statement_id: Nama Mesirnya Djehuty berarti yang seperti ibis.
claims.quote: Thoth's Egyptian name was Djehuty (also dhwty) meaning "He Who is Like the Ibis".

claims.statement: He is commonly depicted ibis-headed or as a seated baboon.
claims.statement_id: Ia kerap digambarkan berkepala ibis atau sebagai babun duduk.
claims.quote: He is most commonly depicted as a man with the head of an ibis or a seated baboon

claims.statement: A Met sculpture shows Thoth as a baboon on a scribe's back.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah arca Metropolitan Museum memperlihatkan Thoth sebagai babun di punggung juru tulis.
claims.quote: Thoth is here shown as a baboon who sits on the scribe's back.

claims.statement: A stela shows Thoth in three forms, including baboon and ibis-headed forms.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah stela memperlihatkan tiga bentuk Thoth, termasuk babun dan sosok berkepala ibis.
claims.quote: Thoth appears three times, from left to right: assimilated with the moon god Khonsu-Harpokrates, in baboon form, and as an ibis-headed crowned figure.

claims.statement: Thoth presided over writing, measurement and calculation.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kepercayaan Mesir, Thoth menaungi kegiatan menulis, mengukur, dan menghitung.
claims.quote: Thoth presided over writing, measuring and calculation

claims.statement: Thoth appears in the scene of weighing the soul.
claims.statement_id: Thoth tampil dalam adegan penimbangan jiwa.
claims.quote: is prominent in the scene of the weighing of the soul

claims.statement: As A'an, Thoth presided over judgment of the dead with Osiris.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud A'an ia berperan dalam pengadilan arwah bersama Osiris.
claims.quote: In his form as A'an, Thoth presided over the judgment of the dead with Osiris in the Hall of Truth

claims.statement: Thoth was patron of scribes.
claims.statement_id: Thoth merupakan dewa pelindung para juru tulis.
claims.quote: He was the patron god of scribes

claims.statement: Tradition attributes creation of written words to Thoth.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Mesir menghubungkan Thoth dengan penciptaan kata tertulis.
claims.quote: Thoth created the written word people used to record their history

claims.statement: Greeks associated Thoth with Hermes Trimegistus.
claims.statement_id: Orang Yunani menghubungkan Thoth dengan Hermes Trimegistus.
claims.quote: to the Greeks Thoth became Hermes Trimegistus

claims.statement: Greeks identified Thoth with Hermes.
claims.statement_id: Orang Yunani mengidentifikasi Thoth dengan Hermes.
claims.quote: Thoth was identified by the Greeks with Hermes

claims.statement: Hermopolis was a cult centre of Thoth.
claims.statement_id: Hermopolis menjadi pusat pemujaan Thoth.
claims.quote: His cult center at Hermopolis was extremely popular.

claims.statement: Accounts vary between self-creation and birth from Set's forehead.
claims.statement_id: Sumber Mesir memuat versi berbeda tentang kelahiran Thoth: mencipta diri atau lahir dari dahi Set.
claims.quote: alternately said to be self-created or born of the seed of Horus from the forehead of Set

claims.statement: Nehemetawy is named as one of Thoth's consorts.
claims.statement_id: Nehemetawy disebut sebagai salah satu pasangan Thoth.
claims.quote: Another of his consorts was the goddess Nehemetawy

claims.statement: In the struggle of Horus and Set, Thoth heals both at different times so that both sides are equally capable and the contest is fair.
claims.statement_id: Dalam perebutan takhta Horus dan Set, Thoth menyembuhkan keduanya pada saat berbeda agar kedua pihak sama kuat dan pertandingan adil.
claims.quote: He heals both Horus and Set at different times in their battle in order to make sure that both sides are equally capable and none can gain advantage over the other so that the contest will be fair.

claims.statement: In every version, Thoth is the scribe who records the events of the contest and offers advice to the gods.
claims.statement_id: Dalam setiap versi, Thoth adalah juru tulis yang mencatat peristiwa perebutan itu dan memberi nasihat kepada para dewa.
claims.quote: In every version, Thoth is the scribe who records the events of the contest and offers advice to the gods.

claims.statement: According to Geraldine Pinch, Thoth was responsible for framing and enforcing the laws of ma'at, and in this role could be either a gracious peacemaker or a merciless executioner.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Geraldine Pinch, Thoth bertanggung jawab menyusun dan menegakkan hukum ma'at, dan dalam peran itu ia bisa menjadi pendamai yang ramah atau algojo yang tanpa belas kasihan.
claims.quote: Thoth was responsible for framing and enforcing the laws of ma'at. In this role he could be either a gracious peacemaker or a merciless executioner.

claims.statement: Ra chose Thoth to fetch the Distant Goddess back from a remote desert; disguised as a baboon or monkey, Thoth succeeded through humility, cunning and perseverance.
claims.statement_id: Ra memilih Thoth menjemput Dewi yang Jauh dari gurun terpencil; menyamar sebagai babon atau monyet, Thoth berhasil lewat kerendahan hati, kecerdikan, dan ketekunan.
claims.quote: Ra chose Thoth to fetch this Distant Goddess back from a remote desert. Disguised as a baboon or monkey, Thoth accomplished his task through humility, cunning, and perseverance.

claims.statement: When Nut became pregnant by Geb at the beginning of the world, Ra was so angry he decreed she would not give birth on any day of the year.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Nut hamil oleh Geb di awal dunia, Ra begitu murka sehingga menetapkan bahwa Nut tidak boleh melahirkan pada hari mana pun dalam setahun.
claims.quote: When Nut became pregnant by Geb at the beginning of the world, Ra (also known as Atum) was so angry he decreed she would not give birth on any day of the year.

claims.statement: Thoth gambled with the moon god Iah for five days' worth of moonlight, won, and made them five days not part of the year, so Nut was able to give birth.
claims.statement_id: Thoth berjudi dengan dewa bulan Iah demi lima hari cahaya bulan, menang, dan membaginya menjadi lima hari yang bukan bagian dari tahun, sehingga Nut dapat melahirkan.
claims.quote: Thoth gambled with Iah, the moon god, for five days' worth of moonlight. He won the gamble and divided Iah's moonlight into five days of sunlight which were not part of the year as decreed by Ra. Nut was then able to give birth

claims.statement: In Plutarch's version, Hermes, playing draughts with the moon, wins a small part of her light and composes five days added to the three hundred and sixty days.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Plutarch, Hermes bermain dam dengan bulan, memenangkan sebagian kecil cahayanya, dan menyusun lima hari tambahan atas tiga ratus enam puluh hari.
claims.quote: Later, playing at draughts with the moon, he won from her the seventieth part of each of her periods of illumination, and from all the winnings he composed five days, and intercalated them as an addition to the three hundred and sixty days.

claims.statement: Thoth was given a seat of honor in the sky boat, and by night helped to drive away the serpent Apophis who sought to destroy the sun god.
claims.statement_id: Thoth diberi tempat kehormatan di perahu langit, dan pada malam hari ia membantu mengusir ular Apophis yang berusaha membinasakan dewa matahari.
claims.quote: Thoth was given a seat of honor in the sky boat which crossed the heavens by day and, by night, Thoth helped to drive away the serpent Apophis who sought to destroy the sun god.

claims.statement: According to Pinch, Thoth and Seshat knew the future as well as the past; they inscribed a person's fate on the bricks on which their mother gave birth and the length of a king's reign on the leaves of the ished tree.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Pinch, Thoth dan Seshat mengetahui masa depan dan masa lalu; mereka menuliskan nasib seseorang pada batu bata tempat ibunya melahirkan dan lama pemerintahan raja pada daun pohon ished.
claims.quote: Thoth and Seshat knew the future as well as the past. They inscribed a person's fate on the bricks on which their mother gave birth and the length of a king's reign on the leaves of the ished tree.

claims.statement: Thoth appears beside Osiris and Anubis in the Hall of Truth as the scribe who has kept account of the deceased's life and records the outcome of the weighing of the heart against the feather of truth.
claims.statement_id: Thoth tampil di sisi Osiris dan Anubis di Aula Kebenaran sebagai juru tulis yang mencatat kehidupan jiwa orang yang meninggal dan hasil penimbangan hati terhadap bulu kebenaran.
claims.quote: Thoth appears regularly at the side of Osiris and Anubis in the Hall of Truth as the scribe who has kept accounts of the life of the soul of the deceased and who records the outcome of the weighing of the heart against the feather of truth.

claims.statement: Thoth's home in the afterlife, the Mansion of Thoth, was a safe place for souls to rest and receive spells against demons who would block them, and his magic revived the soul in the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Rumah Thoth di akhirat, Istana Thoth, menjadi tempat aman bagi jiwa untuk beristirahat dan menerima mantra melawan setan penghalang; sihirnya juga menghidupkan kembali jiwa di dunia bawah.
claims.quote: His home in the afterlife, known as the Mansion of Thoth, provided a safe place for souls to rest and receive magic spells to help them against the demons who would prevent them from reaching paradise. His magic was also instrumental in the revitalization of the soul which brought the dead back to life in the underworld.

claims.statement: In the Book of the Heavenly Cow the creator hands over the rule of humankind to Osiris, while Thoth rules the night sky as the creator's deputy.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Sapi Surgawi, sang pencipta menyerahkan pemerintahan manusia kepada Osiris, sementara Thoth memerintah langit malam sebagai wakil sang pencipta.
claims.quote: hands over the rule of humankind to Osiris (Thoth ruling the night sky as his deputy

claims.statement: The Chimera is a fire-breathing hybrid creature in Greek myth.
claims.statement_id: Chimera adalah makhluk campuran yang menyemburkan api dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: was a monstrous fire-breathing hybrid creature in Greek mythology

claims.statement: The three-headed Khimaira ravaged the Lycian countryside.
claims.statement_id: Khimaira ialah monster berkepala tiga yang menghancurkan pedesaan Lykia.
claims.quote: THE KHIMAIRA (Chimera) was a three-headed monster which ravaged the countryside of Lykia (Lycia) in Anatolia.

claims.statement: Its body combined lion, goat and serpent parts.
claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya memadukan singa, kambing, dan ular.
claims.quote: the body and head of a lion, a goat's head rising from its back, the udders of a goat, and a serpent for a tail

claims.statement: Echidna is named the mother of Chimaera in the Theogony.
claims.statement_id: Echidna disebut ibu Chimera dalam Theogony.
claims.quote: She was the mother of Chimaera who breathed raging fire

claims.statement: Pegasus and Bellerophon slew Chimaera.
claims.statement_id: Pegasus dan Bellerophon membunuh Chimera.
claims.quote: Her did Pegasus and noble Bellerophon slay

claims.statement: King Iobates ordered Bellerophon to slay the beast.
claims.statement_id: Raja Iobates memerintahkan Bellerophon membunuhnya.
claims.quote: The hero Bellerophon was commanded by King Iobates to slay the beast.

claims.statement: Bellerophon rode Pegasos into battle.
claims.statement_id: Bellerophon bertempur dengan menunggang Pegasus.
claims.quote: He rode into battle on the back of the winged horse Pegasos

claims.statement: One version tells of a lead-tipped lance melting in its throat.
claims.statement_id: Satu versi menyebut tombak berujung timah meleleh di tenggorokannya.
claims.quote: drove a lead-tipped lance into its flaming throat, choking the beast on molten metal

claims.statement: Pseudo-Apollodorus says Bellerophon shot the Chimera from the air.
claims.statement_id: Versi Pseudo-Apollodorus menyebut Bellerophon membunuhnya dengan panah dari udara.
claims.quote: flying high into the air brought down the Khimaira with his bow and arrows

claims.statement: The Greek name Chimaera means she-goat.
claims.statement_id: Nama Yunani Chimaera berarti kambing betina.
claims.quote: Chimaera (Χίμαιρα. "she-goat")

claims.statement: The Chimera had three heads.
claims.statement_id: Kepala Chimera berjumlah tiga.
claims.quote: The Chimaera was a three-headed monster.

claims.statement: The Theoi summary names Typhaon and Echidna as its parents.
claims.statement_id: Silsilah dalam ringkasan Theoi menempatkan Typhaon dan Echidna sebagai orang tuanya.
claims.quote: she was a daughter of Typhaon and Echidna, and had three heads

claims.statement: Some later classical writers interpreted Chimera as a Lycian volcano metaphor.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian penulis klasik kemudian menganggap Chimera kiasan gunung berapi Lykia.
claims.quote: Late classical writers believed the creature was a metaphor for a Lycian volcano.

claims.statement: Natural methane flames in western Lycia have been associated with its fiery breath.
claims.statement_id: Situs api alam di Lykia barat dikaitkan dengan napas apinya; sumber tersebut menyebut gas metana.
claims.quote: in western Lycia, one can still see and smell the Chimaera's fiery breath: a natural source of methane gas

claims.statement: Apollodorus reports Typhon and Echidna as its parents.
claims.statement_id: Silsilah versi yang dikutip Apollodorus menyebut Typhon dan Echidna.
claims.quote: according to Hesiod its parents were Typhon and Ekhidna (Echidna)

claims.statement: Nessie is a Scottish folklore creature said to inhabit Loch Ness.
claims.statement_id: Nessie adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Skotlandia yang dikatakan menghuni Loch Ness.
claims.quote: known affectionately as Nessie, is a mythical creature in Scottish folklore that is said to inhabit Loch Ness in the Scottish Highlands

claims.statement: Reports describe a large long-necked creature with one or more humps.
claims.statement_id: Laporan menggambarkannya besar, berleher panjang, dengan satu atau beberapa punggung menonjol.
claims.quote: It is often described as large, long-necked, and with one or more humps protruding from the water.

claims.statement: Evidence is anecdotal and photographs and sonar readings are disputed.
claims.statement_id: Bukti keberadaannya bersifat anekdotal; foto dan pembacaan sonar masih diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: Evidence of its existence is anecdotal, with a number of disputed photographs and sonar readings.

claims.statement: The nickname Nessie has been used since the 1940s.
claims.statement_id: Julukan Nessie dipakai sejak 1940-an.
claims.quote: Since the 1940s, the creature has been affectionately called Nessie

claims.statement: The account of Columba places a water beast in the River Ness.
claims.statement_id: Riwayat Columba menceritakan perjumpaan dengan binatang air di Sungai Ness.
claims.quote: he encountered a "water beast" in the River Ness

claims.statement: The early narrative places the beast in the river, not the lake.
claims.statement_id: Kisah lama itu berlokasi di sungai, bukan danau.
claims.quote: the story very clearly states that is it the River Ness, not the lake, where the beast appears

claims.statement: In the legend Colmcille makes the sign of the cross and orders the beast away.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda, Colmcille membuat tanda salib dan menyuruh binatang itu kembali.
claims.quote: According to legend, Colmcille calmly made the sign of the cross and ordered the beast to return to its home.

claims.statement: Popular interest and belief in the creature has varied since it was brought to worldwide attention in 1933.
claims.statement_id: Minat dan kepercayaan masyarakat terhadap makhluk itu naik turun sejak ia menjadi perhatian dunia pada 1933.
claims.quote: Popular interest and belief in the creature has varied since it was brought to worldwide attention in 1933.

claims.statement: George Spicer and his wife reported an extraordinary creature.
claims.statement_id: George Spicer dan istrinya melaporkan melihat makhluk aneh.
claims.quote: Mr. George Spicer and his wife reported seeing "an extraordinary creature"

claims.statement: The Surgeon's Photograph of Nessie is dated 1934.
claims.statement_id: Foto terkenal yang disebut Surgeon's Photograph terbit pada 1934.
claims.quote: the famous 1934 photograph of 'Nessie', (known as the "Surgeon's Photograph")

claims.statement: That photograph has been discredited as a hoax.
claims.statement_id: Foto tersebut telah dinyatakan tipuan.
claims.quote: has been long discredited as a hoax

claims.statement: The Loch Ness eDNA team took 250 water samples.
claims.statement_id: Tim studi DNA lingkungan mengambil 250 sampel air.
claims.quote: A team of scientists, led by Professor Neil Gemmell, visited the lake in 2018, took 250 samples of its water

claims.statement: The eDNA survey found nothing close to a plesiosaur.
claims.statement_id: Survei DNA lingkungan tidak menemukan bukti yang menyerupai plesiosaurus.
claims.quote: The team could match the DNA they found to many species known to reside in the lake, but nothing even close to a plesiosaur.

claims.statement: The team found a lot of eel DNA.
claims.statement_id: Tim menemukan banyak DNA belut.
claims.quote: However, they found a lot of eel DNA

claims.statement: Eels may explain some Nessie sightings.
claims.statement_id: Belut mungkin menjelaskan sebagian laporan penampakan Nessie.
claims.quote: it is possible that the serpentine eel is responsible for some of the Nessie sightings

claims.statement: Ordinary objects and animals can explain many reported sightings.
claims.statement_id: Benda dan hewan biasa dapat menjelaskan banyak laporan penampakan.
claims.quote: Sightings of the Loch Ness monster can usually be explained by a variety of humdrum objects and animals

claims.statement: In Adomnán's Life of Columba, the saint must cross the river Ness and finds inhabitants burying an unfortunate man.
claims.statement_id: Dalam riwayat Columba karya Adomnán, sang santo harus menyeberangi sungai Ness dan mendapati penduduk sedang menguburkan seorang malang.
claims.quote: he was obliged to cross the river Nesa (the Ness); and when he reached the bank of the river, he saw some of the inhabitants burying an unfortunate man

claims.statement: According to those burying him, the man had shortly before been seized while swimming and bitten most severely by a monster that lived in the water; his body was taken out with a hook, too late.
claims.statement_id: Menurut orang-orang yang menguburnya, lelaki itu belum lama diterkam saat berenang dan digigit parah oleh binatang yang hidup di air; jasadnya yang malang ditarik keluar dengan kait, terlambat.
claims.quote: was a short time before seized, as he was swimming, and bitten most severely by a monster that lived in the water; his wretched body was, though too late, taken out with a hook

claims.statement: When Lugne swam across, the monster, not satiated but roused for more prey, rushed up from the bottom of the stream with an awful roar and its mouth wide open.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Lugne berenang menyeberang, binatang yang belum kenyang dan malah terangsang mencari mangsa itu menyerbu dari dasar sungai sambil mengaum dahsyat dengan mulut terbuka lebar.
claims.quote: But the monster, which, so far from being satiated, was only roused for more prey, was lying at the bottom of the stream, and when it felt the water disturbed above by the man swimming, suddenly rushed out, and, giving an awful roar, darted after him, with its mouth wide open, as the man swam in the middle of the stream.

claims.statement: All present, brethren and strangers alike, were stupefied with terror; Columba formed the sign of the cross in the air and commanded the ferocious monster.
claims.statement_id: Semua yang hadir, baik para biarawan maupun orang asing, tertegun ketakutan; Columba membuat tanda salib dan memerintah binatang buas itu.
claims.quote: Then the blessed man observing this, raised his holy hand, while all the rest, brethren as well as strangers, were stupefied with terror, and, invoking the name of God, formed the saving sign of the cross in the air, and commanded the ferocious monster, saying

claims.statement: At the saint's voice the monster was terrified and fled more quickly than if it had been pulled back with ropes.
claims.statement_id: Mendengar suara sang santo, binatang itu gentar dan lari lebih cepat daripada kalau ditarik dengan tali.
claims.quote: Thou shalt go no further, nor touch the man; go back with all speed. Then at the voice of the saint, the monster was terrified, and fled more quickly than if it had been pulled back with ropes

claims.statement: The beast had come so near Lugne that there was not more than the length of a spear-staff between the man and the beast.
claims.statement_id: Binatang itu sempat begitu dekat dengan Lugne sehingga jarak antara manusia dan binatang itu tidak lebih dari panjang sebatang tombak.
claims.quote: though it had just got so near to Lugne, as he swam, that there was not more than the length of a spear-staff between the man and the beast.

claims.statement: Even the barbarous heathens who were present were forced by the miracle they had seen to magnify the God of the Christians.
claims.statement_id: Bahkan orang-orang kafir yang barbar yang hadir terpaksa memuliakan Allah orang Kristen karena kejadian yang mereka saksikan sendiri itu.
claims.quote: And even the barbarous heathens, who were present, were forced by the greatness of this miracle, which they themselves had seen, to magnify the God of the Christians

claims.statement: Skeptics question the reliability of the narrative, noting that water-beast stories were extremely common in medieval hagiographies and that Adomnán's tale probably recycles a common motif attached to a local landmark.
claims.statement_id: Para skeptis meragukan keandalan kisah itu karena kisah binatang di air sangat tersebar dalam riwayat orang kudus abad pertengahan, dan Adomnán mungkin hanya memakai ulang motif yang sudah dikenal untuk tempat setempat.
claims.quote: Skeptics question the narrative's reliability, noting that water-beast stories were extremely common in medieval hagiographies, and Adomnán's tale probably recycles a common motif attached to a local landmark.
